summary: Futurum Careers, a science-education publication, profiles research by Dr Paul Koch of the University of Wisconsin–Madison on fungicides used on turfgrass. In Futurum's account, fungicides can have negative side-effects, known as non-target effects.

items.title: Futurum Careers on Paul Koch's research: fungicides on turfgrass can have non-target effects
items.origin: Futurum Careers (its profile of Paul Koch's research)
items.quote: While fungicides can do a lot of good, they can also have negative side-effects, known as non-target effects.
items.note: Lawn chemicals are one of the costs the site counts; this is a profile's statement about fungicide side-effects generally, and says nothing about residential lawns specifically.
